CSA DESIGN SYSTEM 1.0
Extracted 2026-10-19 from CSA app source baa4775.

SOURCE OF TRUTH
  dist/design-system/tokens.json
  Three layers: foundation > semantic > component.
  400 tokens in DTCG 2025.10-compatible JSON.
  Every token includes a type, description, and observed status.
  observed-exception retains a component-specific existing value.
  approved-update identifies the requested compact toolbar additions.

GENERATED FILES — DO NOT EDIT DIRECTLY
  tokens.css       CSS custom properties, with aliases preserved.
  tokens-flat.json Resolved inventory used by the visual reference.
  tokens.csv       Flat inventory with slash-separated design names.

REBUILD / VERIFY (FROM THE CSA REPOSITORY)
  npm run design-system:build
  npm run design-system:check
  npm run check
  npm test
  npm start
  Open http://localhost:4173/design-system/

NAMING
  foundation.color.blue.600 = raw value #2563eb
  semantic.color.action.primary = foundation alias
  component.button.primary.background = semantic alias
  CSS: --csa-component-button-primary-background
  Design-tool name: component/button/primary/background
  Prefer semantic and component names for new interface work.

TYPOGRAPHY
  Inter is the interface family; Newsreader is the home greeting.
  Composite typography exports five CSS properties:
  --csa-semantic-typography-button-font-family
  --csa-semantic-typography-button-font-size
  --csa-semantic-typography-button-font-weight
  --csa-semantic-typography-button-line-height
  --csa-semantic-typography-button-letter-spacing
  The composite prefix alone is not a usable CSS shorthand.
  DTCG lineHeight is a multiplier, not a pixel dimension.

COMPONENT CONTRACTS
  Primary action: blue-600 (#2563eb), hover blue-700 (#1d4ed8),
    disabled blue-200 (#bfdbfe); all three states use white labels.
  Secondary action: white background, blue-600 label and border,
    blue-700 label and border on hover, blue-200 label and border disabled.
  Tertiary action: transparent background and blue-600 label;
    hover adds a blue-700 label and outline on white. Disabled uses
    blue-200 text with no fill or border.
  All three action tiers: 46 px height, Inter 16 / 20, 16 px radius.
    Primary labels use weight 700; secondary and tertiary use 600.
    Radius primitives: 4, 8, 16, and 999 px.
    Components reference these primitives through aliases.
  Primary and secondary footer actions share their tier measurements.
    Optional markers use #a3a3a3 at weight 400.
  Disabled icon buttons keep transparent backgrounds and #a3a3a3 labels.
  Accessibility: blue-600 / white is 5.17:1; blue-700 / white is 6.70:1.
    Blue-600 text on the page canvas is 5.02:1. All enabled and hover
    normal-text combinations meet the 4.5:1 AA target.
    Disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums.
  Format chip: #ffe4e6; Audience: #eef2ff; Voice: #ffedd5.
  Variant selected state: #3b82f6 border, #f8f1ee fill, dark text.
  Pending variant: dashed outline.
  Saved variant names and article headings are independent.
  Homepage project cards show the title, creation date, variant count,
    and project menu without a separate Open button or Draft/Sent badges.
    The native title button extends across the card surface and supports
    keyboard activation. Title truncation stays on its inner label.
    Menu controls remain separate siblings above the card's click target.
    Hover fills the card and its border with blue-600; title and metadata
    turn white without an underline. The New Project tile uses the same
    blue-600 hover fill. Keyboard focus outlines the whole project card
    using the shared blue focus ring. The menu keeps its independent target
    and contrasting icon, while its popup retains its white surface.
  Homepage list rows use blue-700 on hover and keyboard focus, with white
    titles, counts, dates, and mobile field labels. Their separate menu
    keeps a contrasting icon and white popup surface.
  Source checkbox: 24 px, outside photo area at top left.
  Icons: Material Symbols use FILL 0 when unselected and FILL 1 when selected. Stateless actions use FILL 1.
    Keep custom SVG geometry where already supplied.
  Editor toolbar: 8 px radius, 2 px top/bottom padding, document-aligned;
    horizontally scrollable
    on small screens. The text-style menu reuses the shared dropdown.
  Title-to-toolbar and toolbar-to-body gaps: foundation.space.20 (20 px).
  New/Edit variant dropdown labels: Inter 14 / 20, weight 600.
  Open dropdown, profile, and project menus: 8 px corner radius,
    including the mobile profile menu.
  Profile and project name labels: Inter 14 px, weight 600.
  New Variant panel: 24 px above the heading, 24 px from heading to
    first dropdown, and 24 px below Add Variant, on desktop and mobile.
  Edit variant field groups are separated by foundation.space.24 (24 px).
  Editorial Direction fields start at two rows, with padding and
    borders added to the current line height. They remain resizable.
  Navigation: hover and active surfaces use neutral gray #f5f5f5,
    with dark gray #404040 labels and icons. Variant hearts use neutral-700 without a persistent circle.
  Profile menu: neutral gray #f5f5f5 hover and focus surface.
    Settings combines name and photo; both save together or cancel together.
    A 14 px filled edit icon in a 32 px circle overlaps the photo
    at bottom right, retaining a 40 px click target.
    Profile Save changes stays disabled until name or photo changes;
    its inactive label and Cancel use #a3a3a3.
  Footer: Inter 11 / 18, muted. Creation time belongs to the
    active variant or original document, using the browser's timezone.

VARIANT STATUS SEGMENTS
  To Create / Created separate pending and ready variants.
  Prefix nonzero counts: "2 to Create", "4 Created"; omit zero counts.
  Inter 14 / 20, weight 600. Radius matches component.dropdown.radius (8 px).
  Selected: button primary background and inverse label. Unselected:
    default surface, primary text, button border (#e5e5e5). No checkmark.
  Empty, unselected To Create and Created use disabled-label gray (#a3a3a3).
  Heading -> segments and segments -> first card: 24 px.
  Cards: 14 px gap. Create action appears only in To Create.
  Arrow keys, Home/End, and roving tab focus select the segment.

ICONS
  All interface pictograms use Google Material Symbols. Selection controls use FILL 0 unselected and FILL 1 selected; stateless actions use FILL 1.
  dist/icons.js is the shared DOM helper and semantic alias map.
  Toolbar formatting uses Material Symbols; Quill renders content only.
  Native checkbox/cursor assets retain official Google symbol paths.
  Font subset names are identical in product and visual reference.
  Preserve accessible labels on controls; glyphs are decorative.

REQUEST REVISION
  Above a created draft, Request Revision sits directly after the source
    count and shares its chip-button styling: 24 px high, pill radius,
    12 px / 500, 1 px border, 1 px vertical / 9 px horizontal padding.
  Uses filled Google edit_note. Opens a native modal with the variant
    title, revision instructions, Cancel, close, and Request Revision.
  Dialog actions share 12 px / 600. Use existing dialog/field tokens.
  Escape/Cancel/close restore focus to the current revision trigger.
  Demo submission shows Revising… on that Created card for four seconds,
    replaces only its body with a different sample, then shows a toast.
  Instructions/completion are saved locally. Jobs resume after reload.
  The editor header has no settings pencil; settings remain on cards.

PASSWORD CARD
  Centered CSA mark and Sign in to continue heading in Inter 20 / 30, weight 600.
  Card maximum width 600 px, content maximum width 400 px.
  Desktop padding 32 px, mobile padding 24 px; corners 16 px.
  Password field, blue information panel, divided product footer, and
    Open workspace action last. Existing demo password behavior is retained.
  Information describes demo access. Footer ends with Powered by Prototype.

PROFILE AVATAR
  Fixed A initial in a 32 px circle, heading-color background with white text.
  Uses interface typography at 16 px / 20 px, weight 600.
  Expanded profile shows the email only, with no name or arrow icons.
  Profile menu contains Log out only; photo and Settings UI are removed.

NAVIGATION RAIL
  Homepage rail remains collapsed and cannot expand by click or keyboard.
  The avatar opens a standalone Log out menu beside the desktop rail,
    or below the mobile top bar. Escape/outside click dismisses it.
  Desktop rail expansion is available inside the project editor, where
    New project and Sources are shown. Returning home closes the drawer.
  Homepage card action menus contain Delete only; no rename action/dialog.

HOMEPAGE LAYOUTS
  Grid/list switch sits at the left of the homepage toolbar; Material Symbols
    view_module / menu, 16 px glyphs in 36 px buttons; 76 × 40 px control.
  Buttons and 2 px padding use component aliases to existing spacing tokens.
  White container, buttons, and light-gray selected surface use the
    navigation panel radius (8 px), with dark icons. Grid is filled when selected and outlined
    when unselected; all other symbols keep the shared filled style.
  Choice is saved locally and supports arrow keys, Home, and End.
  Toolbar height stays fixed across layouts; selection slides and content
    fades/resizes over 200 ms. Reduced motion switches immediately.
  A stable scrollbar gutter prevents horizontal movement between layouts.
  List shows Title, created Variants, Date, and a Delete-only action menu.
  New Project sits at the right of the layout toolbar in list view;
    grid view keeps its New Project tile.
  Date keeps Today / Updated Today semantics.
  Title opens the project. Rows use 14 px Inter, 10 px top/bottom padding,
    and shared dividers/hover.
  Mobile rows stack their details without horizontal scrolling.

HOMEPAGE PROJECT CARDS
  Desktop: 208 px minimum height, 24 px padding and grid gap, 20 px radius.
  Mobile: 104 px minimum height, 16 px padding and grid gap, 16 px radius.
  Reserve two title lines: desktop 18 / 25, mobile 16 / 22. Titles open
    the project, with their own hover/focus state. Options stay separate.
  Card hover/focus-within uses the selected-border token.
  Dates/counts use semantic.color.text.secondary (#737373); inactive
    controls and optional labels retain the muted token (#a3a3a3).
  Unedited projects show Today / Oct 19 using the creation date.
  Projects edited after creation show Updated Today / Updated Oct 19
    using the last edit date. Older years are shown explicitly.
  Legacy trailing — Draft suffixes are removed from project names;
    new projects no longer append the suffix. Variant titles are retained.

RESPONSIVE / INPUT
  Mobile <=768 px. Desktop >=769 px.
  Editor adapts at <=1100 px. Dashboard container thresholds 999/579 px.
  Existing local breakpoints 700/650/480/370 px are preserved.
  Edit styles/app.css, styles/guide.css, or styles/export.css.
  Run npm run design-system:build after style or token changes.
  Query conditions use token(foundation.breakpoint.*) in source CSS;
    the build resolves them for native CSS. JavaScript reads the same
    token properties through design-system/runtime.js.
  Fields: 36 px desktop, 46 px mobile. Icon targets: 40 / 44 px.
  Keep the touch activation helper for Format/Audience selection.
  Keep keyboard focus, selected semantics, reduced motion, and dismissal.

DESIGN TOOL IMPORT
  Use a token importer supporting the DTCG 2025.10 format.
  Check importer support for aliases and composite tokens.
  Map colors and dimensions to variables where supported;
    typography to text styles; shadows to effect styles.
  CSV provides design names and resolved values for manual mapping.
  No native Figma file is included.

SCOPE / REVIEW
  The light theme retains its extracted palette and typography.
  Corner radii use the approved seven-value scale. Compact details use
    2/4 px, variant cards 8 px, controls and menus 10 px, popovers and
    mobile project cards 16 px, dialogs and desktop project cards 20 px,
    and pills/circles 999 px.
  Consolidated radii: 5/6 -> 4; 7 -> 8; 9/12 -> 10;
    14/15/17 -> 16; 18/21/22/23/30 -> 20.
  Custom interface design values, including layout geometry, icon
    targets, typography, colors, and motion, consume shared tokens.
  Product/reference CSS, offline document styles, and interface SVG
    colors are generated. SVG path coordinates remain intrinsic artwork.
  Browser layout syntax (zero, full width, grid tracks, alignment) and
    asset geometry are structural; third-party Quill code is vendored.
  Muted text #a3a3a3 on white remains below the 4.5:1 normal-text
    AA contrast target when used for active content. Primary, secondary,
    and tertiary enabled/hover button labels now meet that target.
  The reference shell has its own documentation layout styles.
  Component specimens inherit the production app stylesheet.

REFERENCES
  https://www.designtokens.org/tr/2025.10/format/
  https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html

SAVED PRESETS / FAVORITES
  Changing Format, Audience, or Voice away from an applied preset clears
    its selection and returns the trigger to My Saved Variants, retaining values.
  Saved preset options include Edit and Delete. Edit reuses the Edit Variant
    panel for name, Voice, and Editorial Direction without altering the
    generated variant body, status, sources, or original settings.
  Unsaved/inactive hearts are outlined and match chevrons (#404040).
  Saved/active hearts are filled rose (#fb7185); hover does not imply saved.
  Variant cards use a white background, 1px gray unselected borders, and
    2px blue selected borders in both pending and created lists.
  Dropdown option hover shares the Sources hover surface (#f5f5f5).
  Draft rating icons share one pill beside Request Revision and open
    feedback with Good or Could be better preselected.

AVATAR PALETTE
  component.avatar.background and foreground alias these colors.

COLOR CONSOLIDATION / EFFECTS
  Eight near-identical gray values now share existing white, neutral,
    and selected-surface tokens. Avatar colors use neutral-700 and white.
  Open dropdown menus use one shared neutral shadow at 8% opacity;
    0px horizontal offset, 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, no spread.
  Loading overlays share white at 90%; canvas fades share the approved Orange 50 at 50% over white tint.
  The collapsed project navigation rail uses the official Google
    chevron_forward path inside a 40 px white circle with a gray border.
  Variant status tabs share the dropdown radius token (8 px), including
    the outside corners of the first and last segments.

SHARED COLOR UPDATES — 2026-10-20
  Active editor formatting uses primary blue-600 with white icons,
    including while hovered. Article links use primary blue-600.
  Keyboard-focus outlines use blue-500; the navigation hover chevron
    uses neutral-700. Invalid-password/upload error text and Delete project
    confirmation hover/focus use red-700. Search thumbnail placeholders
    use the default white surface.
  Saved preset, variant edit, saved-filter, source-preview, upload drag,
    and search-preview interaction surfaces now share neutral-100.
  Saved hearts use neutral-700. Delete variant hover/focus shares the
    Sources icon neutral-100 background and retains its red icon.

FLAT SURFACES
  Cards, dialogs, editor sheets, toasts and mobile panels stay flat.
  Open dropdowns and floating settings/metadata menus use
    semantic.shadow.dropdown: 0px 4px 12px,
    neutral-700 tint at 8% opacity, shared across desktop and mobile.
  Keyboard-focus outlines remain blue-500. Modal backdrop dimming uses
    semantic.color.overlay.scrim; it is independent of elevation.

RETAINED PALETTE
  20 unique color values: 16 solid and 4 transparency/effect values.
  The 37 unused values and their obsolete foundation tokens are removed.
  Legacy, reference, favicon and document-export roles now alias the
    retained palette. Fully transparent gradient endpoints use CSS
    transparent rather than a separate color token.

AUDIENCE VARIANT WORD COUNT
  Target Word Count follows Editorial Direction
    in New Variant and Edit Variant/saved-preset settings.
  Choices: 500–800 (Short), 800–1200 (Medium), 1200–1500 (Long).
  Short is the default for new and legacy records. Each variant and saved
    preset stores its own target. Changing an applied target detaches
    the selected saved preset while retaining other choices.
  Generation remains the existing local demo sample flow.

New Variant field rhythm: 14px between field groups, with a 1px neutral divider and 14px padding above Editorial Direction. Edit Variant keeps its 24px field-group spacing.

Variant selection checkbox: 24×24px indicator, 4px radius, 1px border, 16px checkmark; 44×44px button target.

Target Word Count is visible only when the New Variant audience is nonempty, or when editing a variant/preset configured with an audience. Hiding the control retains its saved preference.

Demo-access information panel: Indigo 50 (#EEF2FF). Retired the now-unused Blue 50 palette entry.

Neutral 100 (#F5F5F5) is also used for subtle fields, feedback fields, search-sort surfaces, upload zone, content-preview header, material-option hover, and favicon background. Retired Neutral 50.

Checkboxes in variant cards, search results and source lists share component.checkbox.size (24px) and component.checkbox.radius (4px). Source and search rows reserve the full checkbox width.
DS usage audit removes 42 tokens with no canonical references. Every retained token is directly used or required by an alias; reference-only entries are listed separately in the usage inventory.

Sources list: headings use the variant-card title size/line-height (14px/1.5), with 600 semibold; supporting snippets are removed from rows. Full content remains in source preview.
All checkbox checkmarks use the official shared white material-check.svg at 16px, including variants, sources and search results.

Source headings use primary blue on hover.

Desktop Sources to Add new source gap: 16px. Add new source to selection-count gap: 16px. Selection count to first row: 8px (no bottom margin + 8px list padding).

Source-preview header label has no background fill.

CSA Home brand text is Neutral 700 by default. Hover uses the primary-blue background with white text.

Serif-formatted article content and serif export text use the shared Newsreader, serif family. Georgia is removed from explicit app/export stacks; the vendored Quill stylesheet is overridden. Newsreader loads normal and italic weights 400–700; HTML exports include the same font request. Generic serif remains the fallback when the font is unavailable. These formats preserve pasted/older saved content; the current editor exposes no font-family selector and its export controls remain hidden.

Variants panel heading and mobile Variants navigation use the filled Material Symbols turn_slight_left icon.

New Variant and Variants headings use a 4px icon-to-text gap; heading icons remain in 20px boxes.

Version-2.0 composer: Format options are Celebrity Relationship Timeline, Listicle, and Who’s Returning to the Show?, plus None Selected. Audience is fixed to General Audience and Voice is fixed to US Weekly. Create variant starts one variant directly; the variant list has no pending/created segments. Saved presets, variant editing, editorial direction, feedback, revision requests, the metadata viewer, keyword generation, and the New Project own-material starter are removed from the product interface. Existing article and preset records remain stored.

The left Sources panel stays open during editing and variant switching until explicitly closed. The navigation folder opens all project sources. A variant’s source-count badge opens Used / Not Used segments, styled with primary blue and white for the selected segment and Neutral 400 for inactive text. Each segment filters the variant’s recorded source snapshots; unused sources start unchecked. Variant-source views omit count summaries and per-row usage labels. Source titles display at most 70 characters and two lines with an ellipsis; hover or keyboard focus reveals the full title.

Canvas update — 2026-10-21
The page canvas uses foundation.color.canvas.orange-50-half: Tailwind orange-50 (#FFF7ED) at 50% opacity over white (#FFFFFF). Its resolved opaque color is #FFFBF6, preventing overlapping surfaces from increasing the tint. The canvas fade shares that resolved color. The semantic canvas alias drives the page, editor tabs and browser theme. The token builder retains OKLCH support for compatible token imports.

Source-link starter — 2026-10-21
New Project uses the plain “Paste a source link” field, without a search icon, upload block, or “or” divider. The field displays five source-link lines (120px at 24px line height), with scrolling for additional links. Continuing with links replaces only the center Content Preview with selectable article cards, one per pasted URL. The Sources and New Content / Variants panels remain part of the workspace. There is no separate search page, Draft button, or Editorial Direction field for this flow. Cards preserve the submitted URLs and show their hostname and a title derived from the path; unavailable publication dates remain explicit. This prototype does not fetch live article metadata. The middle cards control which links are selected for generation; the left Sources list has preview and source actions without checkboxes. Existing Content Preview records remain supported.

Add Content requires a selected source or content, a selected Format, and no generation in progress. None Selected disables the primary action using the shared disabled style; fixed Audience and Voice values do not satisfy the format requirement.

Content queue restored — 2026-10-21
New Variant is renamed New Content, and Create variant is renamed Add Content. Add Content queues a configuration in To Create. The Variants panel again has To Create / Created segments with counts, keyboard navigation, and a Create selected variants action. Generation moves completed items to Created and opens the newest result.

While generating, the Creating… label has a Blue 600 band over a pale Blue 200 base. Reduced-motion preferences show static Blue 600 text.
Pasted source links are checked automatically on import; users can uncheck individual cards. Their choices persist across reloads, and Add Content still requires a format.
The source-card canvas starts with “Ready to Create Content” in the compact regular-weight status-text style above the cards.

Editor toolbar — 2026-10-21
The visible controls are Bold, Italic, Underline, H2, H3, bulleted list, numbered list, link (link_2), Undo, and Redo. H2/H3 toggle paragraph headings and expose their pressed state. The old text-style dropdown and strikethrough control are removed from the visible toolbar; saved document formatting remains supported. The design-system specimen matches the toolbar and retains horizontal scrolling on small screens.

Profile initials now use Tailwind neutral-700 (#404040) backgrounds with white (#FFFFFF) letters. Pink-100 and pink-700 are removed from the token source, lookup, and generated exports. Any retained favorite-color aliases use neutral-700.

Draft and Sent labels use capital initials and match the settings-chip font size (12px). DS selection-field examples use the shared filled keyboard_arrow_down symbol, with an inset matching the product controls, instead of the browser-native select arrow.

Typography specimens use the friendly names Display — serif, Page title, Body text, and Supporting text. Their font sizes, line heights, weights, and canonical token references are preserved.

Typography reference expanded to include homepage card titles (desktop 18/25/700, mobile 16/22/700), responsive display/page titles, panel/dialog headings, source/variant/article titles, H2/H3, metadata, field values, navigation, chips, badges, and button labels. Source usage segments are removed; the Sources panel now shows one list, preserving historical source previews.

Sources has no Add new source button. Focus after source actions moves to a source preview button or the Sources navigation trigger.

The whole New Content heading is an accessible button for collapsing/expanding the form. The mobile close control remains separate.

Destructive confirmation standard — 2026-10-21
Cancel is secondary (white, Blue 600 label/outline); Delete is filled Tailwind Red 700 (#B91C1C), white label, and Red 800 (#991B1B) on hover/press. Both use shared 46px height, 16px radius, 16px/20px semibold labels, and 24px inline padding. Disabled Delete is neutral. The homepage delete confirmation and DS specimen use these shared classes; behavior and focus handling are unchanged.

Radius simplification — 2026-10-21
Status badges and the DS spacing bars use 4px corners. The 2px radius primitive and its DS swatch are removed from source and generated exports. Spacing values retain their separate scale.

Radius consolidation — 2026-10-21
All former 10px corners now use 8px, including fields, dropdown/navigation menus, toolbar, workspace panels, source cards, editor tabs and supporting surfaces. The 10px radius primitive and DS swatch are removed. The scale is 4, 8, 16, and 999px.

Dialog/card radius consolidation — 2026-10-21
All former 20px corners now use 16px. Dialogs, desktop project cards, search fields, and related surfaces share the existing 16px token. The 20px radius primitive and DS example are removed; remaining radii are 4, 8, 16, and 999px.

Quote formatting — 2026-10-21
The editor and DS toolbar include the filled format_quote symbol beside H2/H3. Block quote toggles the selected paragraphs, clears incompatible heading/list formatting, reflects its active state, and supports Undo/Redo and saved document restoration.

2026-10-21: Action labels use Title Case. The generation panel is Adapt Content; its action reads Adapt [count] Content. Target Word Count offers Short (500–800 words), Medium (800–1200 words), and Long (1200–1500 words), defaulting to Short for new projects. Historical length settings remain readable. The selected editor tab bridges the sheet border without a gray line beneath it.
Empty content panels use “No content created yet.” in To Create and “No created content yet.” in Created.

2026-10-21: Pasted-link cards expose the filled visibility eye immediately before the external-link action. The eye opens the existing fictional demo preview independently of source selection; only the top X closes it. Publication dates remain explicit when unavailable; sample headlines and body copy are fictional demo content. New Project accepts website links only and validates the entire input; search text cannot launch a search or create a project from this modal. Existing saved projects remain readable.
The app entry, module graph, and shared stylesheet URLs carry the 20261021-content-cards asset version so newly loaded published pages request the updated behavior.

2026-10-21: Standard Format uses the same fixed-value presentation as Audience and Voice, with the Format chip's pink background. Target Word Count uses the shared three-option dropdown, with a divider separating it from Voice on desktop and mobile.

2026-10-21: Iconography documents outlined unselected states and filled selected states, with a complete icon library showing both variants. The shared app rules apply that state convention to pressed/selected icon controls. Actions without a selection state retain filled icons.

2026-10-21: New Project uses the article URL instructions and both Centredaily/Miami Herald example URLs as multiline placeholder text. The field stays empty and Continue disabled until real URLs are entered. Placeholder text wraps; the empty mobile field expands to show both examples, then returns to five visible lines once populated.

2026-10-21: Source link cards omit photos and show a title, fictional excerpt, Publish Date, and labeled full URL in that order; there is no separate domain label. Opaque article IDs use a matched sample headline in cards, previews, and the Sources list, including older saved projects without modifying their source snapshots. Publish Date and URL labels are semibold; values remain regular. Card body activation starts Adding to CSA feedback while retaining selection; the checkbox and eye/external-link actions remain independent. The Adapt [count] Content button retains that label while card-level progress runs. Editor metadata retains words, save status, and created date only. The preview modal keeps its X and omits its bottom Close action.
Adaptation progress on each content card reads Adapting… and retains the existing blue shimmer. The fixed Standard Format field uses the same Format chip background token.
Initial pasted-link source views open on Content to Create above a white sheet with cream source cards. The To Create badge uses article, a white fill, and a 1px dashed text-colored border. New Content uses post_add; Adapt Content uses article. Both replace the former route icons in the app, Google Fonts subsets, and complete 56-icon DS catalog.
The source tab displays only its To Create badge; the redundant gray Content to Create title and Ready to Create Content heading are hidden. The adaptation segment reads [count] to Create with a lowercase t. Adding to CSA uses the same blue text shimmer and unboxed spinner treatment as Adapting. Sources-list and eye previews share all five fictional paragraphs for URL-only sources without saving demo text into source records. Delete Project includes a top-right X that cancels; closing remains guarded during deletion.
